title: Step 1
criteria: Accept a model shaped like a single downward-pointing triangle, with a long horizontal top edge and two diagonal edges meeting at the lower point. Reject a square or diamond sheet, an upright triangle, or a model with extra flaps visible.

title: Step 2
criteria: Accept a model shaped like an upright kite or diamond, with left and right side points, top and bottom points, and two narrow front flaps meeting along the vertical center near the bottom. Reject a downward triangle or a plain kite or diamond without narrow center flaps.

title: Step 3
criteria: Accept a diamond-shaped model with a clear horizontal crease across the middle and two narrow upright flaps rising from the middle to the top center. Reject a closed kite or diamond that lacks either the horizontal middle crease or the narrow top-center flaps.

title: Step 4
criteria: Accept a model with a large lower diamond, a horizontal middle crease, two triangular side flaps opened upward to the left and right, and a narrow upright flap at the top center. Reject a plain diamond or a model whose side flaps remain folded inward.

title: Step 5
criteria: Accept a model with the upper side flaps visible and a large upward-pointing front triangle covering the center, with its base along the middle crease and its point near the upper center. Reject a model where the front triangle still lies below the middle crease or points downward.

title: Step 6
criteria: Accept a model with upper side flaps visible, a small centered triangle above a wide horizontal band across the middle, and a large downward diamond below the band. Reject a model where the large front triangle is still raised instead of folded into the band.

title: Step 7
criteria: Accept a model with upper side flaps visible, a small centered triangle above the middle band, and a long shallow horizontal base across the bottom. Reject a model with a large downward diamond still hanging below the middle band.
